mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_sync_application(tenant_id,batch_id,plan_id,plan_digest) SELECT p.tenant_id,p.batch_id,p.id,p.digest FROM organization_sync_plan p JOIN organization_sync_batch b ON b.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND b.id=p.batch_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.id=#{id} AND p.batch_id=#{batchId} AND p.digest=#{digest} AND p.ready=TRUE AND b.status='APPLIED'
mapper.select: SELECT plan_id,plan_digest FROM organization_sync_application WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{batchId}
